title: QUIC RFC 9000 Verifiable NEW_TOKEN Envelope Work Item
summary: Implement and prove a listener-scoped NEW_TOKEN envelope with provenance, nonce-backed unpredictability, integrity protection, client-IP binding, expiration, runtime emission, and pre-admission listener validation.
planned_changes:
- Add an internal address-validation token protector.
- Replace opaque random NEW_TOKEN emission with protector-issued token envelopes bound to the validated remote address.
- Validate non-Retry Initial token fields in the listener before admission and mark the initial runtime path prevalidated only after success.
- Add requirement-home positive, negative, edge, and fuzz/property coverage.
- Add a permanent BenchmarkDotNet suite for token issue and validation paths.
- Update canonical trace and regenerated coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, the focused S8P1P1/S8P1P3/S8P1P4 requirement-home filter, the address-validation token benchmark Dry run, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and the full no-build solution test suite.
out_of_scope: One-time token acceptance or replay-cache enforcement.
Persistent token secrets across listener/process restarts.
Observer-linkability closure for all NEW_TOKEN metadata.
Public token cache or callback API design.
Broad interop claims beyond the focused listener/runtime validation floor.
completion_notes: Completed as the verifiable NEW_TOKEN prerequisite and first listener admission floor. Replay and public policy remain follow-on slices.
